title: Arc Raiders Companion
summary: A comprehensive companion web application for Arc Raiders players featuring a searchable database of 1,000+ in-game items, weapons, and gear with real-time data. Includes hideout management, crafting recipes, quest tracking, and trader information.
description: Full-stack game companion app combining real-time API data with custom CMS for community enhancements. Features advanced filtering, progress tracking, and interactive maps.
features: Real-time game data integration via REST API
Advanced search and filtering across 1,000+ items
Progress tracking for hideout upgrades and expeditions
Custom CMS admin panel for content management
Interactive maps with POI markers (in development)
